scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('src')) { cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm install && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); } }"
